plugins.name: glider-maimu
plugins.description: Maimu BLE optogenetic stimulators: a device, a flow node, and pulse-train control.
plugins.author: Laing Lab

plugins.name: glider-sleap-nn
plugins.description: Load SLEAP pose models saved as training_config.yaml + best.ckpt, which is what current SLEAP writes. Converts to ONNX on first use, in a sleap-nn environment it builds for itself. For an older model saved as training_config.json + best_model.h5, install SLEAP Models (Legacy) instead.
plugins.author: Laing Lab

plugins.name: glider-sleap
plugins.description: Load pose models from the TensorFlow generation of SLEAP, saved as training_config.json + best_model.h5. Converts to ONNX on first use; needs no SLEAP install. If your model folder has training_config.yaml + best.ckpt, install SLEAP Models instead.
plugins.author: Laing Lab

plugins.name: glider-dlc
plugins.description: Load DeepLabCut 3.x pose models. Converts them to ONNX on first use, in a DeepLabCut environment it builds for itself.
plugins.author: Laing Lab
